name: Mibu no Tadami
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 41); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: Our courtship, that we tried to hide
poems.author: Mibu no Tadami
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 41
poems.text:
Our courtship, that we tried to hide,
Misleading is to none;
And yet how could the neighbours guess,
That I had yet begun
To fancy any one?
